title: Optimal Alarms for Vehicular Collision Detection
summary: Define collision as the union of overlap events over a horizon and choose an alarm from explicit false-negative/false-positive costs, with Monte Carlo error bounds.

mechanisms.name: Optimal Alarms for Vehicular Collision Detection — dtr:DR51 route mechanism
mechanisms.description: Define collision as the union of overlap events over a horizon and choose an alarm from explicit false-negative/false-positive costs, with Monte Carlo error bounds.
mechanisms.limitations: Vehicle simulations and assumed motion distributions; neither costs nor probabilities transfer automatically.
